d: “I wasn’t on the Ballot and if I was, we would have won in a landslide!' US President Donald Trump blames others for the loss of the republicans in the Midterm 2026 race. US President Donald Trump had a meltdown as US midterm results indicate a blue wave. CBS is projecting Democrats to win both the House and Senate. Early projections suggest Democrats have managed to flip Ohio, Kansas, Texas, Iowa, South Carolina, and North Carolina. In a series of Truth Social posts, Trump claimed that he will become “a political pundit” now. I’m going to become a Political Pundit, both good and bad, on…
